description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object for KPI search filter parameters within the OrangeHRM Performance module. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties and methods to handle job title filtering and sorting functionalities.

classes.name: KpiSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object for KPI search filter parameters, allowing filtering by job title ID and sorting by specified fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object and sets the default sort field to 'kpi.title'.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Retrieves the current job title ID filter value.

methods.name: setJobTitleId
methods.description: Sets the job title ID filter parameter.
